sloka: एवमस्त्विति रामेण पूजयित्वा विसर्जितम् ।अभिप्रेतां दिशं तस्मात्प्रायात्तत्पुष्पकं तदा ।। ७.४१.१५ ॥
transliteration: evamastviti rāmeṇa pūjayitvā visarjitam ।abhipretāṁ diśaṁ tasmātprāyāttatpuṣpakaṁ tadā ।। 7.41.15 ॥

translations.english: Having been worshipped and dismissed by Rama with the words "So be it," the Pushpaka then departed from there towards its desired direction.
